title: Burkhard Heim at Lockheed and extended Heim theory
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Burkhard Heim at Lockheed and extended Heim theory, about 1950s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he was a German, and he ended up moving over to the US and working for Lockheed Martin in the '50s, and was renowned as just a total genius.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a German scientist named Burkhard Heim moved to the United States and worked for Lockheed Martin, a major American aerospace company, in the 1950s, and was seen as a total genius. Heim's name is attached to a physics theory, later expanded as "extended Heim theory", and Michels raises him because, if true, it would place a bold theorist of unusual physics inside a key defense company.
